name: C++ ray tracer on Jolt ZK VM

mentions.name: C++ ray tracer on Jolt ZK VM
mentions.description: A small C++ ray tracer ported to run on the Jolt ZK VM, a zero-knowledge RISC-V virtual machine developed by a16z, as an experiment in running real workloads on blockchain VMs.
mentions.problem: Investigating the computational limits of modern blockchain VMs with compute-heavy real workloads.
